blocks.text: Kapamilya stars brought Filipino-inspired fashion to the red carpet of Star Magical Christmas 2026, which celebrated the spirit of Paskong Pinoy at a hotel in Parañaque on Thursday, Nov. 26. Among the celebrities who graced this year’s gathering were Fyang Smith, Kai Montinola, Maymay Entrata, Maris Racal, Belle Mariano, Lovi Poe, Janine Gutierrez, Francine Diaz and members of BINI, among others. Smith, who was accompanied by her on-screen partner JM Ibarra, served looks wearing a gown made from handwoven mat (banig).
